entries.0d3405bd3f4681b0: In the Timber Business, the company is switching from imported timber, whose prices are affected by exchange rates and shipping costs, to domestically produced timber, whose prices are more stable, and sawing it at its Fukuyama Plant. In the House & Eco Business, with the addition of Kotobuki Tekko Co., Ltd., which has obtained H grade certification, it is stated that both light steel frame and heavy steel frame production have become possible, strengthening its proposal capabilities.
entries.0d804650617c9d02: It manufactures and sells prefabricated houses and steel structures, leases temporary buildings, and undertakes general construction and solar power system contracts. Consolidated subsidiary Kotobuki Tekko Co., Ltd. is responsible for manufacturing heavy steel frames. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥4,357 million.

entries.506b546d3a18f8e5: This is based on the printed analysis by management of financial position, operating results and cash flows, which states the switch to domestically produced timber, the increase in the production ratio of domestically grown cedar and the expansion of production scope through Kotobuki Tekko joining the group, and on the printed management policy, which states the acquisition of H grade certification.
entries.544af0775b8d63b5: Its management philosophy is 'customer satisfaction and employee satisfaction.' Under the medium-term management plan 'NEXT STEP 10' (from the fiscal year ended October 2023 to the fiscal year ended October 2027), the company has been selecting and concentrating its businesses and has withdrawn from the real estate business and unprofitable divisions. In the Timber Business, it will focus on developing new markets and new customers, switching to domestically produced timber and improving production efficiency, and in the House & Eco Business it will work to win orders for school facilities related to government agencies and strengthen design, manufacturing and sales capabilities.
entries.56f7dc36a91a5915: Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥12,639 million, an increase from the previous year, and House & Eco Business revenue grew significantly, reaching 134.0% of the previous year. The main reason for the increase in House & Eco Business revenue is explained as the reflection, from the beginning of the period, of the results of Kotobuki Tekko Co., Ltd., which became a subsidiary in the previous consolidated fiscal year.
